उत्पलावन

UTPALĀVANA . A holy bath in the Panjab. At this place viśvāmitra performed a sacrifice. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 87, Stanza 15).

उत्पलिनी

UTPALINĪ . A river flowing near the forest known as Naimiṣāraṇya. arjuna had seen this river. (mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 214, Stanza 6).

उत्पातक

UTPĀTAKA . A holy bath. Those who bathe in this tīrtha (bath) will get the merits of a fast. (M.B. anuśāsana parva, Chapter 25, Stanza 41).
